headline: Eurotex Industries clarifies significant share price movement to NSE
summary: The National Stock Exchange observed significant price movement in Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited shares. To protect investor interests and maintain market transparency, the exchange sought clarification from the company. Eurotex has since submitted its official response to the exchange. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review the company's disclosure on the NSE website before trading.
why_it_matters: Check company disclosures before trading volatile micro-cap stocks

headline: Eurotex Industries and Exports sends out postal ballot notice
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited has notified the stock exchanges regarding a postal ballot. The company is seeking shareholder approval through this remote voting process. Details on the specific resolutions will be contained in the official notice sent to investors. Retail shareholders holding the stock should review the resolutions and participate in the voting process.
whats_next: Voting results to be announced after postal ballot closure.
why_it_matters: Review corporate resolutions and exercise your voting rights.
